thread:
Maria: Heads up — thinking about surfacing alert provenance + routing hints on the SLO card. Low-risk question: do we want an explicit 'route hint' on the card or keep it behind an API preview? worried about noise and exposing raw policy text to customers.
Sam: my vote — show a compact hint only (e.g. 'Notifies: on-call (PD); Fallback: email'). link to full policy in the API docs.
Chris: +1 for compact. important: we need structured telemetry when a rule fires: rule_id, sample_rate, decision_reason. otherwise debugging is painful.
Maria: we have notify_reason in logs but not in the UI. can we add a small icon + tooltip on the card that surfaces last hit reason?
Ursula: UX idea: tooltip shows last 3 hits (time, brief reason). don't show tenant IDs by default. :eyes:
Taylor: from the API side, propose adding a lightweight field to /slo/summary: notify_preview: [{target, policy, reason, last_trigger}]. keep it tiny.
Sam: prefer we avoid deep nesting in the public contract. small structs are fine but keep it versioned.
Chris: example payload idea —
```json
{"notify_preview":[{"target":"pagerduty","policy":"soft-backoff-v2","reason":"error_rate_thresh","last_trigger":"2026-01-18T14:03:00Z","sample_rate":"1/10"}]}
```
Maria: nice. one ops concern: adding this will increase response payloads and frontend telemetry. can we only fetch details on hover or when SLO is in-breach?
Ursula: we already sample full SLO context for 1% of requests. proposal: 100% show compact hint; 1% detailed context + detailed payload on hover.
Taylor: technical match: add ?include_notify_preview=true query param for console requests (default false). console will fetch compact hint from main endpoint and request detailed preview on hover.
Chris: also add a prometheus metric notify_preview_hits_total{policy=...,target=...} so we can track noise and policy churn.
Sam: I'll draft an RFC for the API change + migration plan. include an opt-in flag for early customers.
Maria: I'll open a GH issue and attach a quick mock: rwi/infra #5234. any strong objections to tooltip-first rollout?
Ursula: none from UX. widget size should stay minimal. :+1:
Taylor: sgtm. tagging @eng-oncall to watch for PD noise during canary.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout for feature/alert-provenance -> canary (10%).
incident-bot: incident-bot: creating monitor 'pd-noise-proxy' threshold=50/min (temporary)
Maria: thanks — i'll prepare the PR, UX mocks, and the API snippet for the RFC.
Chris: I'll add a short dashboard query for tracking notify_preview_hits and example alert rule to the PR.
